newsitem.title: SYRIA: SYRIA TENDERS TO BUY 26,000 T WHITE/RAW SUGAR.
newsitem.headline: SYRIA TENDERS TO BUY 26,000 T WHITE/RAW SUGAR.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and foodstuffs (GEZA) has issued a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws, a GEZA spokesman said on Thursday.
he said September 9 was set as final date to receive price offers and that the two amounts should be shipped in October. Results of the tender would be made on September 10, the official said.
GEZA also issued a tender on Wednesday to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment between September 20 and October 20.
